text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time had passed since full-scale training
with Buena Vista began in preparation for the Make Debut.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay!
I'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For today's interval training, we will alternate between a 200m jog and an all-out sprint. First, the jog, and then—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hmph...! Yaaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her full-sprint speed remained as brilliant as ever,
showing steady growth.
A run that felt like it could extend boundlessly—
choice_data_list: (Overflowing with talent, ever since way back when...)

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Buenavista really is amazing.
Isn't she the best of her generation?

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Right. Whichever path they choose...
they're bound to be the center of attention.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We haven't discussed the details yet.
However, I know the scenery I want to reach.
That is—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san!
Give it all you've got!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Special Week...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Buena!
Have some milk and take a breather!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Special Week. A senior horse girl who has racked up countless brilliant victories up to now. Among them――

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Japan's "Supreme Commander,"
Special Week, is charging in!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Even defeating the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe Umamusume, she takes a magnificent,
magnificent victory in the Japan Cup!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Among the gathering of world-renowned Umamusume,
her magnificent victory representing Japan
in the Japan Cup remains vividly in memory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Buena Vista, who witnessed it with me at the venue back then...
Engulfed in frenzy, shock, and deep emotion—we said in unison:

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: What a breathtaking view...!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Right. Someday, we definitely will too—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —"Someday, without fail, we will reach a breathtaking sight like this."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The one who gave all of us such a dazzling dream was... Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san was simply magnificent
during that 'Japan Cup'...!
Don't you agree, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah! Starting right from the paddock, the sheer dignity—
Yeah! Starting with their presence in the paddock—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
W-Waaah~! C-Can we stop?
You're making me blush~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
L-Let's not talk about me today—
let's talk about Buena-san over here!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ Look what I found!
An article about Buena-san!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
For... me?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a break, I decided to read the magazine
that Special Week brought over...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"This Year's Featured Umamusume!"
"Pre-debut yet drawing massive attention!
The rising star of high expectations, Buena Vista!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Look! Buena-san is the only one
who got a full-page feature
even before her debut~!
choice_data_list: You're right, it's amazing, isn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... That's so kind of you!
Wait, but why——... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "Will she become the heroine of the new 'Triple Tiara route'?!" ...it says.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the Classic year of the Twinkle Series,
two major routes exist.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown route.
It's the collective name for three races: the Satsuki Sho,
the Japan Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week walked this path and went on to win the
Japanese Derby, a dream for everyone in the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho, the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho!
Collectively, these three races make up the Triple Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Lately, the girls coming out of this route have been causing quite a stir, haven't they~!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: You're right! Even in the magazines—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "Sweep Tosho, claiming victory in the Takarazuka Kinen as a Tiara Umamusume for the first time in 39 years, ushering in the 'Tiara' era—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "Vodka—the first Tiara Umamusume in 64 years to conquer the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby)—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "Daiwa Scarlet, who defeated her at the Shuka Sho and clinched 2nd place at the Arima Kinen, ushered in a brand-new era."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"—In other words, this is an era where Umamusume who excel on the Tiara route are the truly 'strong' ones!"
...Ooooh~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Now, now,
what comes next is the important part~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Buena Vista already possesses a brilliant presence in the Academy.
Hopefully, this top-tier Umamusume will—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "We look forward to seeing her shine on the Tiara route. And as a 'heroine of the era'—we hope she further invigorates the world of Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...
This might be a little too much of an honor...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"That just goes to show
how high the expectations are for you, Buena-san!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I see! Buena-san,
you were aiming for the Tiara route!”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it, that's perfect for Buena-san!
I really want to see her become
the heroine of an era♪
choice_data_list: No, to be honest, I haven't decided on a goal yet.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah! S-Sorry for jumping the gun~!
I totally thought it was already decided...!
choice_data_list: (With the way this magazine wrote it, no wonder you'd think that)
(With the way this magazine wrote it, no wonder you'd think that, huh?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The public is fired up over the momentum of the Tiara line.
It's understandable to expect the next new heroine, but...
choice_data_list: (Buena's own wishes come first, of course.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So after training ended,
I asked once more about
her hopes for future goals...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
A goal...
...Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I want to take on the Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you look surprised.
...Was it not what you expected?
choice_data_list: I was sure you'd go after Spe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week was our idol.
So naturally, I assumed the conversation
would lead to following in her footsteps...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown path that Spe-san walked...
That one is very appealing too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“Still, just as that magazine said...
the recent momentum along the Tiara route is incredible.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"If we can win there...
don't you think we'll see an incredible view?"
choice_data_list: Indeed... it looks like this will be something unprecedented.
Indeed... it looks like this will be something unprecedented.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Right?
Besides...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "A breathtaking view that reaches everyone"—carrying the hopes and dreams of as many people as possible, reaching that place together with everyone... That is our dream.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Then I want to take the path everyone desires.
Because that's where the breathtaking view I seek must be.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“—Since everyone believes in me, I want to deliver.
Because everyone's dream is my dream, too!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista's eyes sparkle with determination.
While everyone else chases their own personal dreams, she...
readily embraces the hopes and expectations of others as well.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...?
Trainer?
choice_data_list: No. ...We've decided on our big goal!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Let's aim for it—the Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the center of the era—
The primary goal for the Classic year has been set.
